Q: lambda boolean equality operator usage without outer triger mechanism A:

They're common but they're not particularly a good idea. In fact, most linters will tell you that usually, when you're able, replace a lambda with a simple function. Lambdas are a relatively late addition to the Python runtime and are crippled compared to Lambdas in other languages.

For some illustrative examples, read e.g. https://pylint.readthedocs.io/en/stable/user_guide/messages/convention/unnecessary-lambda-assignment.html

In the wild, I most often see these used as arguments to Pandas grouping and filtering functions, and they're nearly always unnecessary and a performance hit compared to methods that can avoid them.
